summary: Frontend-only Playwright test at 390x844 of Sketch Titles, Text Labels and Gallery Search, plus a sketch regression. TITLES PASSED: a name typed in sketch-title-input is saved. In the gallery, sketch-gallery-title-{id} shows the name with the section title ('Jaundice & Bilirubin') underneath. An unnamed sketch falls back to the section title. The /topic/liver section thumbnail shows the name. Re-opening ?sketch=id prefills the name, and editing and saving updates it. A title-only change triggers the leave prompt. LABELS PASSED (functionally): Text mode highlights the button and shows sketch-text-hint. Tapping the canvas opens 'Add a label'. Done renders the svg text (with a halo) in the current ink colour, e.g. #2F6FDE. A label-only sketch can be saved. Tapping an existing label opens 'Edit label' prefilled. Cancel makes no change, Done updates the text, Delete removes the label, and clearing the text then pressing Done removes it. Dragging a label moves it with no modal; a 3px move counts as a tap. Undo reverses adding, editing, moving, deleting, clearing the text, a stroke and an erase. Clear (after confirm) removes strokes and labels, and undo restores them. Labels persist in localStorage, after reload, and in the gallery and section thumbnails. SEARCH PASSED: matches the name ('couinaud'), label text ('CAUDATE'), section ('jaundice') and chapter ('the liver'), case-insensitive. 'zzzz' shows sketch-gallery-no-results, and clearing the search shows all sketches again. REGRESSION PASSED: draw, erase split, undo, save, delete with confirmation, the empty state, ink switching back from the eraser, and read-all-notes-button plus 17 section-speak buttons. Two web-only bugs were found (see ui_bugs). No deprecated packages were found.

ui_bugs.component: Canvas coordinate mapping after the text hint shows or hides
ui_bugs.issue: Turning Text mode on or off shows or hides sketch-text-hint, which moves the canvas 18px (box y 170 <-> 188). The first press after the toggle still maps coordinates with the old box. The first label after entering Text mode lands 18px (43 units) below the tap: expected y=360, got y=403. The next tap was correct (840 vs 839). The first stroke after leaving Text mode starts with a visible hook, because its first point is 18px too high. Root cause: onPanResponderGrant calls measureInWindow, which is async, and then calls point(e) straight away with the stale box. onLayout does not fire because the canvas size did not change. Reference: app/sketch/[sectionId].tsx:153-156,170,304

ui_bugs.component: SVG label text gets selected on web, and the gesture gets stuck
ui_bugs.issue: On web, dragging anywhere on a canvas that has labels selects the svg <text> labels; window.getSelection() returns 'Portal vein' and it shows as a blue highlight. With a selection active, the next eraser drag was terminated after its first move. The grey eraser ring (#9AA0A6) stayed on the canvas permanently, the erase was partial, and the ring path was still there after Clear. Reproduced twice. RNW terminates the responder on selectionchange, and there is no onPanResponderTerminate handler, so live is never cleared and a stroke drawn in draw mode would be lost. Fix: make labels unselectable (userSelect:'none' on the canvas/Svg, or pointerEvents='none' on the Svg) and add onPanResponderTerminate that runs the same logic as release. Reference: app/sketch/[sectionId].tsx:146-213, src/components/sketch-canvas.tsx:23-39

issues: Label text is about 5px tall in the 110px gallery thumbnails and 84px section thumbnails, so it is unreadable there. This is acceptable, but a larger label size or a minimum could be considered.
The section thumbnail strip shows no caption for an unnamed sketch, while the gallery falls back to the section title. This is a minor inconsistency.
The 'Leave without saving?' text says 'Your new strokes will be lost' even when only the title or labels changed. Suggest 'Your changes will be lost'.
Labels placed near the left or right edge are centred on the tap point (textAnchor middle), so long labels can get cut off at the canvas edge.

action_items: Fix the stale canvas box: in onPanResponderGrant, compute coordinates from a box measured synchronously (on web, getBoundingClientRect of the canvas node) or from nativeEvent.locationX/Y. Alternatively, re-measure whenever mode changes, or reserve fixed space for sketch-text-hint so the canvas never moves.

Stop text selection on the canvas on web: userSelect:'none' (and WebkitUserSelect) on the canvas View/Svg, or pointerEvents='none' on the Svg. Add an onPanResponderTerminate handler that runs the same logic as onPanResponderRelease (clear live, commit the stroke, finalise the erase snapshot).
Optional: change the leave-prompt copy to 'Your changes will be lost'; show the section title as a fallback caption on section thumbnails.
critical_code_review_comments: saveLabel always takes a snapshot and sets dirty when editing an existing label, even if the text is unchanged. Pressing Done without changes adds a no-op undo step and makes the leave prompt appear.
localStorage value is double JSON-encoded (storage util stringifies a string). This works, but it's worth knowing for debugging.
There is no onPanResponderTerminate handler (see ui_bugs).

success_rate.frontend: 90% - all requested flows work functionally; 2 web gesture bugs

seed_data_creation: Used fresh browser contexts with localStorage only (TEST_ prefixed sketches), and deleted the last one via the UI. No server data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use header-back-button for the editor's back button. localStorage key sono_study_sketches_v1 is double-encoded: set it with JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(obj)). Each label renders 2 svg <text> nodes (halo + fill); the odd index is the coloured one. To reproduce the stuck ring: add 2 labels in text mode, leave text mode, draw a horizontal stroke (this selects label text), choose the eraser, then drag; the ring path #9AA0A6 stays. To check the offset: enter text mode, then tap at 0.3 of the canvas height; the label y is 403 instead of 360.
rca_of_issue: 1) The hint appears or disappears, the canvas moves 18px, onLayout doesn't fire (same size), and grant calls point(e) before the async measureInWindow callback updates box.current. 2) The browser selects the svg <text> during mouse drags, RNW ResponderSystem terminates the active responder on selectionchange, and with no onPanResponderTerminate the live ring or stroke stays and the gesture is never committed.
